name: app-scam-protection-long-scroll-case-study
title: Scam Protection Long-Scroll Case Study
whatItIs: A tall pastel case study for a scam-protection app: a huge two-tone headline over a phone with floating pastel feature pills, project metadata, a 3D robot knight with a security shield, and a text cloud around 'Stay Protected From Modern Scams'.
whatItMeans: Soft mint and lavender pills soften a scary topic, while the playful robot adds personality and reassurance.
techniques: Headline partly hidden behind the phone for depth
Feature pills at different heights orbiting the device
Pastel quick-action tiles inside the UI
Tag cloud arranged around a centred statement

vocabulary.definition: A rounded label naming a feature, floated near a device.
Words in pills scattered around a central statement.
A character used to humanise a product.
